propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently follow Unix rule of silence, making successful writes and idempotent no-ops indistinguishable on stdout, forcing agents to run verify reads and sometimes misinterpreting silence as failure.
Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a one-line kubectl-style confirmation on success (past-tense verb + args summary) and 'no change: reason' for idempotent no-ops, both exiting 0.
Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the router top-level before partition dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) and reopen must normalize to the shared confirmation contract without information loss, preserving all existing data in the new format.
The link REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical before/after on write and no-op paths including under --quiet, with exactly one stdout result per invocation and no extra confirmation line added.

Consumed seam return types (e.g. add_dependency's dict | None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged in type and meaning; outcome signaling must use parallel channels for seams that cannot distinguish wrote-vs-noop from existing return values.
